newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Singapore urges fidelity to fight AIDS.
newsitem.headline: Singapore urges fidelity to fight AIDS.

text.p: The Singapore government on Monday recommended people remain loyal to their spouses to avoid infection of the deadly HIV virus.

The advise followed data showing the number of new HIV cases in the city-state rising 25 percent in 1996. There were 139 new cases of people infected with HIV, the virus that causes AIDS, the Ministry of Health said.
"The Ministry would like to emphasise that the only way to avoid AIDS is to remain faithful to one's spouse and to avoid casual sex or sex with prostitutes," it said.
It said Singapore now had 558 HIV cases, mostly men. It said 271 of them had AIDS.
